newsitem.title: USA: Inacom developing investment cost product.
newsitem.headline: Inacom developing investment cost product.

text.p: Inacom Corp said Monday it is developing a service to give companies specific return-on-investment information and expects it to be available in the first half of 1997.

The service will be a follow-up to Inacom Asset RollCall, which provides an inventory of a company's assets. Inacom Asset ROI (return on investment) calculates a three-year, total cost of ownership model based on the client's information technology set-up, the company said.
Inacom said the service will help companies make decisions, for example, on whether to switch to a new software, based on costs over time.
Inacom is a technology management services company.
